title: Quifted
description: Get back those extremely funny Minecraft nights.
body:
**Quifted** is the perfect modpack for those nice Minecraft evenings with your friends.
This modpack gives you a mostly closed mod experience with some completly random mods to bring fun in those lame repeting modpack patterns. 
For example:
> You just finished your ME-System, what do you do next?
> Right biuld a track and race Your **car** to the limit. 

> You ask why?
> BECAUSE you can.

> Your neigbour is to loud?
> NO, problem, just trigger a **Deathray** in their house.

This pack has something for everyone:
- Builders
- Explorers
- Fighters
- Technicians
- Crappy PC Owners
- Racers

You might have gotten the point, this isn´t your normal Minecraft mod experience.
It´s **THE** experience.

**Note**: If you play on a Macbook, please activate the **McMouser** Mod so you can left and right click while holding ctrl. If you are on windows you should deactivate it.
